name: explain
prompt: what does main.go print? answer in one sentence
check: go run . | tail -1 | grep -qx 34 && grep -q 'fib(n-1)' main.go

name: doc-comment
prompt: add a doc comment above fib explaining it
check: grep -B1 '^func fib' main.go | grep -q '^//' && gofmt -l main.go | wc -c | grep -qx 0

name: iterative-fib
prompt: make fib iterative instead of recursive
check: go run . | tail -1 | grep -qx 34 && ! grep -q 'fib(n-1)' main.go

name: add-test
prompt: add a table-driven test for fib in main_test.go and make sure it passes
